title: What brings you here today?
lede: Choose a way in. Each is a short practice, guided one step at a time, with nothing to prepare. Everything you do here stays on this device.

log.title: Day by day
log.lede: Kept in this browser and sent nowhere, unless you make an account to keep it on your other devices too. A filled day means you practised.
log.empty: Nothing yet. Your days and journal will appear here as you practise.
log.clearConfirm: Clear your practice record and journal? If you have an account, it is cleared on your other devices too. This cannot be undone.
log.locked: Locked. Open it with your journal passphrase in My space.

month.title: A month of lunar days
month.lede: Each day’s tithi, worked out from the moon at sunrise in India, with the sacred days marked. Close to a panchang, but it can differ by a day near a change; Sarvakali’s panchang decides.

days.title: The nights that matter
days.lede: New and full moons are worked out from the moon itself (to within a few hours; a panchang gives the exact tithi). Festival dates are from public calendars, to be confirmed with Sarvakali’s panchang.
days.amavasyaNote: The new moon, a night especially kept for Kali.
days.amavasyaDo: A suggestion: light a lamp after dark, sit in silence for a few minutes, and offer what you are ready to release.
days.purnimaDo: A suggestion: a slow evening, gratitude for what has grown, and the mala once round.

reminder.title: A gentle daily reminder
reminder.text: Add a reminder to your own calendar, every day at the time you choose. It works today, with no sign-up.
reminder.add: Add a daily reminder to my calendar
reminder.addedNote: Saved. Open the file to add a daily reminder to your calendar.

mine.title: The ones you keep
mine.lede: Tap ✦ on any mantra to keep it here, with how often you have chanted it. Kept on this device only.
mine.empty: None yet. Tap ✦ on any mantra in the library to keep it here.

doors.title: Today’s practice
doors.text: One practice for today, about ten minutes, in the spirit of the day.

doors.title: Be with a deity
doors.text: Twelve practices, each with one deity: who they are, a verse, a mantra, a question.

doors.title: Work with a feeling
doors.text: Grief, fear, anger, a decision, gratitude: a practice for how you are.

hub.deitiesTitle: Who would you like to be with?
hub.deitiesLede: Each practice introduces the deity, offers one verse to read and one mantra to repeat, and a question to sit with.
hub.feelingsLede: Each practice meets a feeling as it is: with breath, with words that have held people for centuries, and with one question.
hub.doneNone: None yet. When you finish a practice it appears here.

deeper.title: The mantra library
deeper.text: Every mantra, prayer and verse, by day, deity and intention, each with its meaning and pronunciation.

deeper.title: The seven days
deeper.text: Each planetary day: its character, its question, and all its mantras.

deeper.title: Tools for practice
deeper.text: The mala, the fire, the diya, the moon calendar, sacred days and reminders.

session.plan: What you will do · about {n} minutes
session.keepJournal: Keep it in my practice journal (on this device only)
session.offerLabel: What would you like to let go of?
session.first: Your first day. Come back tomorrow, at the same time if you can.

tools.title: The mala, the fire, the lamp and the moon
tools.lede: Small practices to use on their own, the moon calendar, and reminders for your own calendar.
